Fixture pages

All images are generated drawings (npm run fixtures); none come from real comics.

  • Paged: ko-p01, ja-p01, zh-p01, en-p01, es-p01, blob: URL, crossorigin
  • Webtoon: IntersectionObserver, loading=lazy, eager, cookie-gated, slow CDN, ko-strip01, es-strip01
  • Seams: gap 0, gap 4
  • Formats: WebP slices, srcset and picture
  • Hotlink protection: Referer (origin is enough), Referer (full page URL)
  • Navigation: infinite chapters, SPA (pushState), prerender
  • Hard cases: canvas only, tainted canvas, strict CSP + Trusted Types, frames

CDN tools: request log, generated files. Routes and query knobs: tools/fixture-server/README.md.
